rationale: Instruments the website's single conversion journey: turning visitors into supporters through the Súmate panel. Funnel: sumate_opened, sumate_help_type_selected (money), donation_frequency_selected, payment_flow_started, donation_result_viewed (approved). North Star: approved donations and their amount in COP. Country, city, session and UTM parameters are captured automatically by Mixpanel and are not sent manually. Payment method and monthly amount are chosen inside Bold and Mercado Pago and are not visible to the site. No personal data is collected; session replays block all images because the site shows photos of minors.
